objects.sustainability_focus: Induced Drag Reduction & Jet Fuel / CO2 Conservation
objects.description: Streamlined laminar airfoil profile. Moving the air jet across the wing demonstrates how smooth airflow generates lift while minimizing wake turbulence and fuel consumption.

objects.sustainability_focus: Frontal Surface Area Optimization & Aerodynamic Efficiency
objects.description: High-downforce open-wheel racer. Demonstrates how managing frontal stagnation zones and diffuser flow cuts drag power dramatically while maintaining cornering grip.

objects.sustainability_focus: Vortex Shedding Mitigation & Embodied Material Savings
objects.description: Tall aerodynamic architectural structure. Demonstrates how high-altitude wind pressure induces vortex shedding, and how aerodynamic tapering reduces structural steel and HVAC wind infiltration.
Non-streamlined bluff body. Demonstrates massive boundary layer separation, large turbulent wake eddies, and severe pressure drag compared to engineered shapes.
